🔐 SoleKey - Zero-Knowledge Password Manager

Every password manager promises: "Your data is safe with us."

SoleKey makes a different promise: your data is never with us.

No accounts. No servers. No central vault to breach. Your PIN is the only key - and it exists only in your mind.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
READ THIS FIRST
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If you forget your PIN, your secrets are gone. Permanently.

This isn't a flaw - it's the architecture. Any password manager with recovery has a backdoor somewhere. SoleKey has none.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When a centralized password manager is breached, every user is exposed. SoleKey has no central vault - each user's secrets live on their own device and their own Google Drive, encrypted independently with their own PIN. Breaching one user gives an attacker nothing about any other user. No single point of failure.

Switch phones? Your encrypted backup is in your own Google Drive - Google sees encrypted bytes, we see nothing, and only your PIN unlocks it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
HOW IT WORKS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

You choose a PIN. That PIN never leaves your mind.

Your secrets are encrypted on your device with AES-256, keyed to your PIN. Backups to Google Drive carry only encrypted bytes. No central server. No recovery mechanism.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CREDENTIALS & 2FA
• Passwords and usernames
• Built-in TOTP authenticator - passwords and 2FA codes in one place
• Strong password generator

CREDIT CARDS
• Store card number, expiry, CVV, cardholder name
• Auto-detects card type (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, more)
• Scan your card with your camera (OCR)

AUTOFILL
• System-wide autofill for apps and browsers
• Credentials stay encrypted until you authenticate

SECURITY DASHBOARD
• Password health score (0–100)
• Detect weak, reused, old, and breached passwords
• Breach check via k-anonymity - your passwords never leave your device

BIOMETRIC UNLOCK
• Fingerprint or face unlock for convenience
• Secured by your phone's hardware chip - not just a software check
• Your PIN remains the true encryption key

BACKUP & PORTABILITY
• Google Drive backup - secrets encrypted before upload, stored in your own account
• Export to password-protected ZIP
• Import from Chrome, Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass, KeePass
• Desktop Chrome companion extension - read-only access from your computer

PRIVACY BY DEFAULT
• Works completely offline
